messages.subject: Re: problem tilling windows
parts:
Hi Robersy,
The factor levels cause a problem, the chr column of the data has many
other levels corresponding to other chromosomes but only one
chromosome is actually in the dataset. I guess you are using a subset
of the original dataset.

doing the following will work for now before the tileMethylCounts()

methyWt$chr=as.character(methyWt$chr)

Best,
Altuna

On Mon, Jun 17, 2013 at 6:51 PM, Robersy Sanchez <rob...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi Altuna
>
> I am trying to get the base counts over tilling windows across the a
> chromosome and I got the following error:
>
> Wt <- tileMethylCounts(methyWt, win.size = 1000, step.size =
> 1000,cov.bases=0)
> Error in rep(chrs[i], numTiles) : invalid 'times' argument
> In addition: Warning messages:
> 1: In max(IRanges::end(g.meth[seqnames(g.meth) == chrs[i], ])) :
> no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
> 2: In is(seqnames, "Rle") : NAs introduced by coercion
>
> I have partitioned this chromosome into windows of 1000 bp using my own
> script but with other purpose. So, I could not figure out where is the
> problem.
> Could you please give me a tip about what is happening?
>
> Best,
>
> Robersy
>
> Note: please find enclosed the methylRaw object for the chromosome
>
